name: devgon
description: devgon's modular and innovative web project
author: devgon<devgonteam@gmail.com> - Gontar

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:ci: concurrently "npm run dev:ci --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test:ci: echo '▶️ BACKEND TESTS' && npm run test:ci --prefix backend && echo '▶️ FRONTEND TESTS' && npm run test:ci --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: echo '📦 Building BACKEND...' && npm run build --prefix backend && echo '🌐 Building FRONTEND...' && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix backend && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.format:fix: npm run format:fix --prefix backend && npm run format:fix --prefix frontend
scripts.check:code-style: echo '🧹 LINTING BACKEND' && npm run lint --prefix backend && echo '🧹 LINTING FRONTEND' && npm run lint --prefix frontend && echo '🎨 FORMAT CHECK BACKEND' && npm run format --prefix backend && echo '🎨 FORMAT CHECK FRONTEND' && npm run format --prefix frontend
